title: Ten locality accounts now lead on their existing place routes
summary: Complete AI-reviewed readings cover Roseville, Genesee County, Malta, the GlobalFoundries Vermont / Essex Junction locality, Canton, Baytown, Easton, Beaverton, Camas and Yakima Basin. Their existing identities and original records remain intact. The Place Atlas, collection cards, search catalog and decision export carry the current articles without adding duplicate places.
evidence_note: Exact historical dossier, geographic-check, eligibility, follow-up and source-context inputs are retained. No fresh source retrieval is claimed. The Vermont parcel/location discrepancy and Malta funding reconciliation remain unresolved; ADI's shared proposed ceiling is not a site allocation, and Yakima's entitlement forecast is not final delivery. Existing eligibility remains 25 place candidates, not 35 and not completion of the 70-place goal.
publication_effect: Local article completion and actual owner-authorized AI editorial review only. No municipal boundary, current title/compliance finding, operating observation, human review, independent certification, publishing permission, deployment or launch is created.
